response.justification: Bogdan brings 15+ years of broad engineering experience, including high-throughput distributed systems work (Sociomantic/Dunnhumby) and current hands-on involvement in AI-agent tooling and MCP frameworks at re:cinq, which aligns well with the AI-native mindset the role demands. However, the resume shows no mention of Python, which is an explicit must-have, and lacks concrete evidence of stakeholder management, incident response/on-call ownership, or agile ceremony participation at the depth expected for a Staff-level, cross-functional role.
strengths: Direct current experience with AI-agent infrastructure, MCP code generators, and agentic workflow tooling
Proven distributed, high-throughput systems experience (millions of HTTP requests/sec at Sociomantic/Dunnhumby)
Long, diverse technical career spanning web, mobile, embedded, and backend with demonstrated ownership (founder of GISCollective, workshops, open-source libraries)
concerns: No mention of Python anywhere in skills or experience, despite it being an explicit must-have
No explicit evidence of on-call/incident-response ownership or operational monitoring responsibilities
Limited detail on cross-functional stakeholder management or agile/scrum ceremony participation (e.g., scrum champion rotation)
